title: Brian Donohue
subtitle: Hi, I’m Brian. I’m originally from Fort Lee NJ, of Chris Christie Bridgegate fame, and spent several years living in Brooklyn NY before moving to Oakland CA. I went to college at a small, private technology school in Hoboken NJ called Stevens Institute of Technology, where I majored in Computer Science and graduated with High Honors. posts.title: Au Revoir, Tumblr
posts.description: After 18 years, the Instapaper blog is moving off of Tumblr in favor of Jekyll on GitHub Pages. For several years now I’ve been really embarrassed about the state of Instapaper’s blog.
